51/S0.subgoal: Describe the relationship between VR session duration and cyber sickness symptoms.

51/S1.subgoal: Analyze how virtual world size, speed, and interaction impact exposure duration.

51/S2.subgoal: Compare and contrast the two approaches to optimizing VR exposure duration.

51/S3.subgoal: Formulate the minimum time path problem using a graph structure.

51/S4.subgoal: Explain the structure and constraints of the graph representing the virtual world.

51/S5.subgoal: Define the edge weights in the graph based on direct connectivity or lack thereof.

51/S6.subgoal: Calculate the travel time between two directly connected points of interest using a natural walking model.

51/S7.subgoal: Adapt the minimum travel time problem into a variation of the Traveling Salesman Problem.

51/S8.subgoal: Detail the algorithmic steps required to solve the modified TSP and derive the optimal path.

51/S9.subgoal: Evaluate the limitations of the minimum time approach and introduce the method for maximizing coverage within a time limit.
